name: The Talker
description: A first-through who gets invited in. Fifteen, and the only candidate in Yards history to talk an instructor out of failing them, on the record, in front of the board.
narrative:
You read people the way the Tinker reads a coupling collar: fast, from the
outside, and usually right. It has got you through two years of training that
your arms were never going to get you through.

You know the thing nobody says out loud about this job -- that almost every
disaster on the far side of a door is a person who decided something, and a
person who decided something can be talked to.

powers.name: Life Support
boosts: A toxic atmosphere and heat, both (2 PP)
limits: External Power Source -- the pressure-skin, and it can be taken

powers.name: Heightened Sense
powers.knack: THE READ -- you see what people are doing and about to do. Rare, resented, hard to live with.

powers.name: Lucky
powers.knack: Yours, not the suit's. It survives the locker.

extras.charge: Power Points = POW 13; recovers 1 per minute of rest
extras.conditioning: Lucky is theirs, not the suit's -- it survives the locker
extras.fray: Raise crossings by one for every transit. A knack deepens as it climbs and so does the damage; they are one process. Landlocked is a long way off at this count, and the player should be told that once.

actor_notes: A PLAYABLE PRE-GEN. If the player chose this one, it is theirs -- never voice it, never decide what it notices (TABLE.md section 5). If they chose another, this one stays in the world as a fellow first-through in the same intake, run as an NPC, and should turn up at the Nine between missions.
